registration: Affine to independent symmetric MNI template; seed 123; 2 ITK threads
mean_family_weighting: equal family weights, then mean of scans within family

mri_roi.selection: Target anatomy inspected before alternative scores; posterior cortical folding, fixed first atlas case.

case_selection: First existing atlas case for each modality; no score-based case replacement.
metric_scope: All nine inpainting package outputs, 2D adaptation; official leaderboard names MSE/PSNR/SSIM.
limitations: One real example per modality, descriptive only.
Affine correspondence is not exact folding correspondence.
Later MRI visit is years apart; no repeat-based noise floor.
Acquisition protocol matching not individually verified.
No real segmentation ground truth; synthetic shape metrics are not assigned to real images.
N4 uses full source images; diagnostic comparison, not a masked-input inpainting method.
